attempts.summary: Enabled XFS user-quota accounting on node1's root filesystem (rootflags=uquota via grubby + fstab usrquota, requiring one reboot to activate), created the datauser account, set its /srv/data home directory, applied a filesystem-enforced 100MB (soft=hard) XFS user quota for datauser, and verified enforcement both before and after the mandatory node restart-evidence reboot.
